messages:
Ava Curator: Heads-up — I'm triaging the last 3 open-model PRs for the catalog. Quick status + asks so we can close the intake this sprint. TL;DR: perf profiles merged? licensing checks done? canary plan?

Ravi Kumar: Perf profiles pushed to branch `catalog/perf-profiles/2024-11`. Mostly finalized for seq-length 512 and 1024. Still tuning batch sizes for T4 vs A10x.

Maria Chen: Licensing question on `zephyr-lite-v2`: license header says 'Apache-2.0 with third-party exceptions' — is that green? @LegalBot can you confirm?

LegalBot: quick check: Apache-2.0 OK for redistrib, flagged 1 third-party deps that need attribution. No copyleft issue. Recommend adding vendor attribution file in the model package.

Jamie L: FYI CI is flaky on the perf-profile PR — failing on the quant step. Error: `RuntimeError: unsupported dtype bfloat16 on device`

Sanjeev Patel: For the quant errors, can we fallback to q4_0 for the canary? Suggest adding a model-variant label and an automatic fallback in routing policy so staging traffic still flows.

Ravi Kumar: Good call. I'll add a `variant:q4_0` and a routing weight 10% canary -> 100% fallback if primary fails. Patch coming in a few mins.

ops-bot: Canary scheduled: dashboard.redwood.internal/canary/zephyr-lite-v2 — start 2024-11-08T15:00Z, 30m window. Alerts wired to #eng-oncall.

Ava Curator: Action items I'm collecting: 1) @Ravi add fallback variant + fix quant CI; 2) @Maria add vendor attribution file and confirm commit; 3) @Jamie validate canary smoke tests and attach logs; 4) @LegalBot drop short note so ops can attach to release. Can everyone ack?

Maria Chen: Ack — I'll add `VENDOR_ATTRIBUTION.md` to the model tar and push today.

Ravi Kumar: Ack — starting on the quant CI debug now. Will open PR and tag reviewers: @Sanjeev @Jamie

Jamie L: Ack — can run smoke tests after Ravi's PR and will post results here. If smoke fails, I'll route traffic to `zephyr-lite-v2:q4_0` manually.

Sanjeev Patel: I'll update routing policy after Ravi's PR lands. Also filing a small infra task to allow per-variant fallback TTL.

Ava Curator: Awesome, thanks. Can we try to close the intake checklist by EOD PST? If anyone is blocked, drop a screenshot/log here and we'll escalate. :thumbsup:

LegalBot: official note: license okay pending attribution file. Saved to intake ticket #ML-1123.

Ava Curator: Perfect — closing loop for now. Will post final checklist and release notes snippet once all PRs are green. Ping me if you need a hand with the canary dashboard.
